WITH 
-- 2025 yılı siparişlerini bul
yil_siparisleri AS (
    SELECT siparis_id
    FROM siparisler
    WHERE tarih LIKE '2025%'
),

-- Kategori bazında ciro hesapla
kategori_ciro AS (
    SELECT 
        u.kategori,
        COALESCE(SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat), 0) AS ciro
    FROM urunler u
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT kategori FROM urunler) k
    LEFT JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON u.id = sk.urun_id AND sk.siparis_id IN (SELECT siparis_id FROM yil_siparisleri)
    GROUP BY u.kategori
),

-- Toplam 2025 cirosu
toplam_ciro AS (
    SELECT SUM(co.ciro) AS toplam
    FROM kategori_ciro co
    WHERE co.ciro > 0
)

SELECT 
    cc.kategori,
    ROUND(cc.ciro, 2) AS ciro,
    ROUND(cc.ciro * 100.0 / (SELECT toplam FROM toplam_ciro), 1) AS yukse,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cc.ciro DESC, cc.kategori ASC) AS sirasi
FROM kategori_ciro cc
ORDER BY cc.sirasi, cc.kategori ASC;
